app.title: Browser tab title and wallet-connect app name on pages that set none of their own. The product name.
app.description: Search result and link-preview description for the whole site. One sentence.

actions.goToMarkets: Button on the 404 and crash pages that leaves for the market list.
actions.tryAgain: Button that repeats a failed read or re-renders a crashed page.
actions.reload: Button on the crash page shown when the app itself failed to start; does a full page reload.
actions.close: Screen-reader label for the × that closes a sheet or dialog.

errors.reference: Small print under an error, giving the ID that matches it to the server log. {digest} is an opaque hex string; <code> sets it in monospace.

notFound.metaTitle: Browser tab title on the 404 page.
notFound.title: Heading of the 404 page.
notFound.body: Explains the 404: the link is wrong, possibly truncated when shared.

routeError.eyebrow: Small label above the heading when one screen fails to render.
routeError.title: Heading when one screen fails to render; the rest of the app still works.
routeError.body: Reassures that a rendering error cannot touch funds.

globalError.metaTitle: Browser tab title when the whole app failed to start.
globalError.eyebrow: Small label above the heading when the whole app failed to start.
globalError.title: Heading when the whole app failed to start.
globalError.body: Reassures that a rendering error cannot touch funds.

page.needsWallet: Heading of the placeholder a screen shows when it needs a connected wallet. The body under it is screen-specific.
page.notConfigured: Heading of the placeholder a screen shows when this network has no contracts for it.

nav.mainLabel: Screen-reader name of the desktop sidebar navigation.
nav.primaryLabel: Screen-reader name of the phone tab bar.
nav.testnet: Badge at the bottom of the desktop sidebar: this deployment is on a test network.
nav.more: Fifth tab in the phone tab bar; opens a sheet with every other destination. Max 8 characters.
nav.moreTitle: Heading of the phone's More sheet.

sections.bet: Group heading in the phone's More sheet: markets and your positions.
sections.yourMoney: Group heading in the phone's More sheet: staking, borrowing and history.
sections.fundIt: Group heading in the phone's More sheet: lending to the pool.
sections.runIt: Group heading in the phone's More sheet: liquidating and operating markets.
sections.learn: Group heading in the phone's More sheet: the explainer.

links.markets: Nav item: the market list, the home page.
links.portfolio: Nav item: your stake, debt, health and positions in one place.
links.stake: Nav item: deposit into or withdraw from the vault.
links.borrow: Nav item: borrow against your stake, or repay.
links.stocks: Nav item: loans against tokenized stock.
links.lend: Nav item: supply the lending pool.
links.operator: Nav item, shown only to a market's owner: open rounds and publish prices.
links.howItWorks: Nav item pinned at the bottom of the sidebar: the explainer for newcomers.

tabs.markets: Phone tab bar label for the market list. Max 8 characters; set in capitals.
tabs.portfolio: Phone tab bar label for the portfolio. Max 8 characters; set in capitals. Shorter than the sidebar's word on purpose.
tabs.stake: Phone tab bar label for staking. Max 8 characters; set in capitals.
tabs.lend: Phone tab bar label for lending. Max 8 characters; set in capitals.

wallet.connect: Header button that connects a wallet.
wallet.connecting: Disabled header button while a wallet connection is in progress.
wallet.cancelled: Quiet hint under the connect button after the person dismissed the wallet prompt.
wallet.failed: Quiet hint under the connect button after a connection failed for another reason.
wallet.noResponse: Quiet hint under the connect button when the wallet went silent mid-connection.
wallet.inThisBrowser: Group heading in the wallet menu: wallets installed in this browser.
wallet.otherWallets: Group heading in the wallet menu: WalletConnect, when browser wallets are also listed.
wallet.mobileWallet: Group heading in the wallet menu: WalletConnect, when it is the only way to connect (usually on a phone).
wallet.disconnect: Tooltip on the connected-address button; clicking it disconnects.

network.wrong: Warning banner when the wallet is on another network and its name is unknown. <lead> is set bold. {expected} is a network name.
network.wrongWithWallet: Warning banner when the wallet is on another network. <lead> is set bold. {expected} and {actual} are network names.
network.switching: Banner button while the wallet is switching networks.
network.switchTo: Banner button that asks the wallet to switch. {chain} is a network name.
network.declined: Hint under the switch button after the person declined the switch in their wallet.
network.addChainFirst: Hint under the switch button when the wallet does not know this network. {chain} is a network name.
network.couldNotSwitch: Hint under the switch button when the switch failed for another reason.
network.noAnswer: Hint under the switch button when the wallet went silent.

explorer.newTab: Screen-reader text after every block-explorer link: it leaves the app.

misconfigured.eyebrow: Small label above the heading on the screen a broken deployment shows instead of the app. Read by whoever deployed it.
misconfigured.title: Heading of the broken-deployment screen.
misconfigured.body: Explains the broken-deployment screen. {count} is how many build settings are wrong; a list of them follows.
misconfigured.rebuild: Footnote on the broken-deployment screen: the settings are fixed at build time.

feed.reading: Placeholder for a market's name while its price feed is read from the chain.
feed.demo: Badge on a market whose price is set by hand by the operator, not by Chainlink.
feed.chainlink: Badge naming the oracle network a market settles against. A brand name; not translated.

sides.yes: One of a round's two answers, on buttons, labels and outcomes.
sides.no: The other of a round's two answers.

taken.yes: Which side a position took, in the positions list. Lowercase, inline.
taken.no: Which side a position took, in the positions list. Lowercase, inline.
taken.both: A position that took both sides of one round, in the positions list.
taken.none: A position with nothing on either side, in the positions list.

phases.open: Phase chip: the round is taking positions.
phases.cutoff: Phase chip: entry has closed and the round is about to lock.
phases.running: Phase chip: locked, waiting for the closing price.
phases.settled: Phase chip: the round has a winner.
phases.voided: Phase chip: the round was cancelled and every stake refunded.
phases.unknown: Phase chip when the contract reports a phase the app does not know.

age.justNow: How long ago a price was published, under 90 seconds. Follows 'printed'.
age.minutes: How long ago a price was published. {minutes} is a whole number under 60.
age.hours: How long ago a price was published, in whole hours. {hours} is a count.
age.hoursMinutes: How long ago a price was published. {hours} and {minutes} are counts; h and m are abbreviations.

amount.overWallet: Error under an amount field when the amount exceeds the wallet's token balance.

question.asked: A question market's own wording, from its contract. {text} is passed through untranslated.
question.unnamed: Title of a question market whose contract has no readable question.
question.higherAt: Round title on an older market with no strike. {asset} is a ticker (ETH); {at} a time of day.
question.higherAtClose: Round title with no strike and no close time. {asset} is a ticker.
question.priceHigherAt: Round title before the feed is known. {at} is a time of day.
question.priceHigherAtClose: Round title before the feed and close time are known.
question.aboveAt: Round title: the yes/no question. {asset} is a ticker, {level} a dollar price like $2,690, {at} a time of day.
question.above: Round title with no close time. {asset} is a ticker, {level} a dollar price.
question.priceAboveAt: Round title before the feed is known. {level} is a dollar price, {at} a time of day.
question.priceAbove: Round title before the feed and close time are known. {level} is a dollar price.

markets.title: Page title of the market list, the home page.
markets.subtitle: Subtitle under the market list and market page titles.
markets.notConfigured: Body of the 'not deployed here' placeholder on market screens.
markets.unreadable: Shown instead of the market list when the chain read fails.
markets.empty: Shown when the market registry is empty.
markets.heading: Section heading above the list of markets.
markets.includesDelisted: Note beside the heading. {count} is how many delisted markets are shown because you hold a position in them.
markets.emptyCategory: Shown when a category tab has no markets. {category} is a tab name; <link> goes to all markets.
markets.categoriesLabel: Screen-reader name of the category tabs.

categories.crypto: Category tab: markets on crypto prices.
categories.stocks: Category tab: markets on tokenized stock prices.
categories.questions: Category tab: markets settled by a claimed outcome, not a price.
categories.other: Category tab: markets that fit none of the others.

markets.settledByClaim: Under a question market's title, where a price market names its feed.
markets.marketFallback: Name of a market whose feed has no readable description.
markets.delistedHeld: Tag on a market the owner delisted, still shown because you have money in it.
markets.horizon: How long each round of a market runs. {horizon} is a short duration like 5m or 1h.
markets.entryClosesIn: Countdown on a market row. {countdown} is mm:ss; <time> sets it in figures.
markets.noRound: On a market row with no live round.
markets.nothingStaked: On a market row whose live round has no money in it.
markets.sayYes: Follows a large percentage: the share of the pool on Yes. Lowercase.
markets.splitLabel: Screen-reader text for the Yes/No split bar. {yes} and {no} are whole percentages.

spot.lastPrice: The latest price when it is over 30 minutes old. {price} is a number; <figure> sets it in figures.
spot.now: The current price. {price} is a number; <figure> sets it in figures.
spot.printed: When the price was published. {age} is a phrase like '2 min ago'.
spot.tooClose: After the price move, when it is too small to say which side is winning.
spot.ahead: After the price move: which answer is currently winning. {side} is yes or no.

market.title: Page title of a single market.
market.unreadable: Shown instead of a market when the chain read fails.
market.notAMarket: Heading when a market URL names an address the registry does not know.
market.back: Link from the unknown-market answer to the list.
market.allMarkets: Back link at the top of a market page.

marketMeta.fallbackTitle: Browser tab and link-preview title for a malformed market URL.
marketMeta.title: Browser tab and link-preview title for a market. {name} is its feed name, like ETH / USD.
marketMeta.live: Link-preview description of a market. {id} is a round number, {phase} the indexer's phase word, {up} and {down} pool amounts.
marketMeta.idle: Link-preview description of a market with no rounds. {name} is its feed name.

roundMeta.fallbackTitle: Browser tab and link-preview title for a malformed round URL.
roundMeta.unknownTitle: Title for a round the indexer has not found. {id} is the round number, {name} the market's feed name.
roundMeta.title: Browser tab and link-preview title for a round. {name} is the market's feed name, {id} the round number.
roundMeta.wonOnClaim: Link-preview description of a settled question round. {winner} is yes or no.
roundMeta.won: Link-preview description of a settled price round. {winner} is yes or no; {strike} and {close} are prices.
roundMeta.voided: Link-preview description of a voided round.
roundMeta.voidedBecause: Link-preview description of a voided round. {reason} is the indexer's reason, in English.
roundMeta.live: Link-preview description of a live round. {phase} is the indexer's phase word; {up} and {down} are pool amounts.

roundPage.title: Page title of a round's receipt. {id} is the round number.
roundPage.subtitle: Subtitle of a round's receipt page.
roundPage.back: Back link from a round to its market.
roundPage.unreadable: Shown when the indexer request for a round fails; the raw error follows.
roundPage.missing: Heading when the indexer has no such round. {id} is the round number.
roundPage.missingDetail: Explains a missing round when the indexer's progress is unknown.
roundPage.missingDetailIndexed: Explains a missing round. {block} is the indexer's latest block number.
roundPage.outcome: Card heading: how the round ended.
roundPage.indexedTo: Small print: how far the indexer has read. {block} is a block number.
roundPage.pool: Card heading: the money on each side.
roundPage.total: Row label: both sides of the pool together.
roundPage.rakeTaken: Row label: the protocol's cut taken at settlement.
roundPage.clock: Card heading: when the round opened, locked and closed.
roundPage.opened: Row label: when the round started taking positions.
roundPage.locked: Row label: when entry stopped and the start price was taken.
roundPage.closed: Row label: when the closing price was taken.
roundPage.price: Card heading: the two prices the round settled on.
roundPage.strike: Row label: the price the round is measured against.
roundPage.strikeNotSet: In place of the strike before it exists.
roundPage.closeNotSettled: In place of the closing price before settlement.
roundPage.terms: Card heading: the round's status fields.
roundPage.status: Row label: the contract's status word, shown as the indexer reports it.
roundPage.phase: Row label: the phase word, shown as the indexer reports it.
roundPage.lastTouched: Row label: the last block that changed this round.
roundPage.block: Value of 'Last touched'. {block} is a block number.
roundPage.won: The outcome of a settled round. {winner} is yes or no.
roundPage.voided: The outcome of a voided round; the indexer's reason may follow.
roundPage.running: The outcome of a round that has not settled. {phase} is the indexer's phase word.

marketBlock.termsUnreadable: Shown when a market's rake and entry cutoff cannot be read.
marketBlock.noRounds: Shown on a market that has never had a round.
marketBlock.live: Section heading: rounds that have not settled.
marketBlock.liveEmpty: Under 'Live' when there are no live rounds.
marketBlock.settled: Section heading: settled and voided rounds.
marketBlock.marketFallback: Name of a market whose feed has no readable description.
marketBlock.readingBadge: Badge while the market's feed type is being read. Lowercase.
marketBlock.demoExplainer: Explains a demo market. <lead> is set bold as a warning.
marketBlock.chainlinkExplainer: Explains how a Chainlink market settles.
marketBlock.readingExplainer: Shown while the market's feed type is unknown.
marketBlock.contractMarket: Label before the market contract's explorer link.
marketBlock.contractOracle: Label before a question market's oracle contract link.
marketBlock.contractFeed: Label before the price feed contract's explorer link.
marketBlock.sheetTitle: Title of the sheet for taking a position. {side} is yes or no; {round} the round number.
marketBlock.side: The chosen answer, large, at the top of the position sheet. {side} is yes or no.
marketBlock.onRound: Beside the chosen answer. {round} is the round number.
marketBlock.fromWallet: Amount field label: money paid in from the wallet.
marketBlock.walletMax: Button that fills the field with the wallet balance.
marketBlock.borrowed: Amount field label: money borrowed against the vault stake.
marketBlock.capacityMax: Button that fills the field with the most that can be borrowed.
marketBlock.overCapacity: Error when the borrowed amount exceeds what can be borrowed.
marketBlock.working: Submit button while a transaction is being signed or mined.
marketBlock.take: Submit button when the amount is invalid. {side} is yes or no.
marketBlock.approveAndTake: Submit button when an approval must be signed first. {side} is yes or no.
marketBlock.takeAmount: Submit button. {side} is yes or no; {amount} a figure; {symbol} a token symbol.
marketBlock.healthAfter: Label of the before → after health factor preview.
marketBlock.borrowingNote: Explains the borrow. {amount} is a figure; {symbol} a token symbol.
marketBlock.healthDanger: Warning when the borrow leaves the health factor in the danger band.
marketBlock.connectToTake: Shown beside the connect button when a visitor presses a side.
marketBlock.claimed: Under a settled round whose winnings you already collected.
marketBlock.yourPosition: Under a settled round with nothing to claim. {amount} is a figure; {symbol} a token symbol.
marketBlock.toClaim: Under a settled round you won. {amount} is a figure; {symbol} a token symbol; <figure> sets it in green.
marketBlock.claiming: Claim button while the transaction is in flight.
marketBlock.claim: Button that collects a round's winnings.

roundCard.round: Link to a round's own page. {id} is the round number.
roundCard.youreIn: Badge on a round you hold a position in.
roundCard.untilEntryCloses: Tooltip on the countdown while entry is open.
roundCard.untilStartPrice: Tooltip on the countdown after entry closes.
roundCard.untilSettles: Tooltip on the countdown while the round runs.
roundCard.strike: The round's reference price. {strike} is a number.
roundCard.strikeToClose: Reference and closing price. {strike} and {close} are numbers.
roundCard.thin: Warning while one side of the pool is under the minimum.
roundCard.entryClosed: Explains the entry cutoff. {seconds} is a whole number of seconds.
roundCard.nothingStaked: In place of the odds bar on an empty round.
roundCard.onYes: Under the odds bar, left. {amount} is a figure; {symbol} a token symbol.
roundCard.onNo: Under the odds bar, right. {amount} is a figure; {symbol} a token symbol.
roundCard.noOdds: On a side button while that side is empty. Lowercase.
roundCard.pays: On a side button. {percent} is its share of the pool; {multiple} what 1 staked returns, like 1.84.
roundCard.won: Before your amount under the winning side. Keep the trailing separator.
roundCard.yours: Your stake under a side button. {amount} is a figure; {symbol} a token symbol.
roundCard.lastPrice: The latest price when it is over 30 minutes old. {price} is a number.
roundCard.now: The current price. {price} is a number.
roundCard.printed: When the price was published. {age} is a phrase like '2 min ago'.
roundCard.tooClose: After the price move, when it is too small to say which side is winning.
roundCard.ahead: After the price move: which answer is winning. {side} is yes or no.
roundCard.unusable: After the price when the oracle adapter would refuse it.
roundCard.awaitingStrike: On an older market with no strike yet, while entry is open.
roundCard.settingStrike: On an older market with no strike yet, after entry closes.
roundCard.thePriceFeed: Stands in for the feed's name in the settlement line when it is unknown.
roundCard.settlement: How the round is decided. {state} is done or pending; {name} the feed name; {at} a 24-hour UTC time; <feed> links to the feed on the explorer.

resolution.heading: Heading of the panel explaining a question round's claimed outcome.
resolution.canArgue: While a claim can still be challenged and the deadline is unknown.
resolution.canArgueFor: While a claim can still be challenged. {left} is a duration like 1h 30m.
resolution.claimedBy: Row label: the address that proposed the outcome.
resolution.theirStake: Row label: how much the proposer has in this round.
resolution.stakeUnreadable: Value when the proposer's stake cannot be read.
resolution.stakeNothing: Value when the proposer holds nothing in the round.
resolution.evidence: Row label: the link the claim cites.
resolution.digest: Row label: the hash of the evidence document.
resolution.arguedBy: Row label: the address that challenged the claim.
resolution.ruledBy: Row label: the arbiter who decided a challenge.
resolution.reasoning: Row label: the link to the arbiter's reasoning.

headline.open: Where a question stands: no claim yet.
headline.proposed: Where a question stands: claimed, answer unreadable.
headline.proposedAnswer: Where a question stands: claimed. {answer} is yes or no.
headline.final: Where a question stands: final, answer unreadable.
headline.finalAnswer: Where a question stands: final. {answer} is yes or no.
headline.unknown: Where a question stands when its state is unknown.

terms.heading: Section heading: the rules of the protocol, read from the contracts.
terms.unavailable: Shown when the lending terms cannot be read.

staking.title: Group heading.
staking.yieldRate: Term name; its value is an annual percentage.

borrowing.title: Group heading.
borrowing.maxLtv: Term name: the maximum loan-to-value ratio.
borrowing.thresholdNote: Explains the liquidation threshold when the LTV is unknown.
borrowing.thresholdNoteGap: Explains the liquidation threshold. {gap} is a percentage.
borrowing.kink: Term name: where the borrow rate curve steepens.

liquidated.title: Group heading.
liquidated.full: Term name; its value is a health factor.

rounds.title: Heading of the per-market round terms table.
rounds.rake: Table column, and the heading of its explanation below.
rounds.beforeLock: Table cell. {duration} is a short duration like 15s.

fees.heading: Operator console section heading.
fees.rakeTitle: Card title. {market} is a shortened contract address.
fees.predatesTreasury: Shown for an old contract. <code> sets a function name in monospace.
fees.goesTo: Label before the withdrawal destination address.
fees.reading: In place of the destination while it loads.
fees.setDestination: Button that sends the new destination.
fees.overAccrued: Error when the amount exceeds the balance.
fees.working: Button while the withdrawal is in flight.
fees.ownerYou: Beside the button when the connected wallet is the owner.
fees.ownerReading: Beside the button while the owner loads.
fees.ownerOther: Beside the button for anyone else. {owner} is a shortened address.

claimAll.heading: Label above the total claimable amount.
claimAll.nothingLeft: Under the total once everything is claimed.
claimAll.count: Under the total. {count} is how many rounds; {signatures} is the signatures sentence.
claimAll.signatures: How many wallet prompts claiming takes. {count} is the number of rounds.
claimAll.claiming: Button while claims run. {current} and {total} are counts.
claimAll.claimOne: Button when one round is claimable.
claimAll.round: One row in the claim run. {id} is a round number.
claimAll.notSigned: Row status: the person dismissed the wallet prompt.
claimAll.skipped: Row status: the claim would revert, so it was not sent. {reason} is the contract's error name or a phrase.
claimAll.failed: Row status: sent and failed. {reason} is the contract's error name or a phrase.
claimAll.refused: Stands in for {reason} when the chain gave none.
claimAll.revertedOnChain: Stands in for {reason} when a sent claim was mined and reverted.
claimAll.collected: After a claim run. {amount} is a figure; {symbol} a token symbol.
claimAll.leftToSign: Appended after 'Collected'. {count} is a number. Keep the leading separator.
claimAll.skippedCount: Appended after 'Collected'. {count} is a number. Keep the leading separator.
claimAll.failedCount: Appended after 'Collected'. {count} is a number. Keep the leading separator.
